description: Revokes every sign-in JWT issued for the merchant so far - this MCP, other agents and the dashboard in every browser - the same action as Sign out everywhere in the dashboard profile settings. Needs a fresh JWT. Afterwards this MCP holds no JWT and no OTP wallet: sign in again with auth_send_otp + auth_verify_otp. API keys and smart-account session keys are NOT revoked: cached sk_* keys keep working until api_keys_revoke.
name: auth_sign_out_everywhere
title: Sign out everywhere
